<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read the input matrix
input_df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Compute missingness per indicator
input_df['missing_count'] = input_df.apply(
    lambda row: input_df[row['indicator']].isna().sum(), 
    axis=1
)

# Compute missingness rate
input_df['missing_rate'] = input_df['missing_count'] / input_df['missing_count'].notna().sum()

# Filter indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30
filtered_df = input_df[input_df['missing_rate'] <= 0.30]

# Write the missingness report
output_report_path = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
filtered_df.to_csv(output_report_path, index=False)

# Write the selected matrix
output_matrix_path = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'
filtered_df.to_csv(output_matrix_path, index=False)

print("Processing complete.")
print(f"Report written to: {output_report_path}")
print(f"Selected matrix written to: {output_matrix_path}")
</solution_file>
